author: Christian Birzer
name: ExportToPublish
description: A custom export storage that copies exported files to a chosen folder, tags them, and can open that folder in the file manager.
description-extensive: Adds an export destination that copies your finished images into a folder you choose, adds keywords to them, and can open your file manager at that location — handy for gathering and labelling photos you plan to publish and tracking where each one was shared.
